proved_this_run.statement: If mu has mass m and density cap M, then for 0<alpha<1, sup_t int |x-t|^-alpha dmu <= [2^alpha/(1-alpha)] M^alpha m^(1-alpha).

For p>2, driver mass m, beta-pushforward density cap L, receiver W with density<=1, conditional core densities q_z independent of W and S_p=int||q_z||_p^p dnu, the mixture of T_z+aW^2+beta(z)W satisfies ||p||inf <= C_p m^((p-2)/p)L^(1/p)S_p^(1/p), C_p=2^(2/p)((p-1)/(p-2))^((p-1)/p), uniformly in a, translations, support geometry and moments.

For fragments nu_j with masses m_j, projection caps L_j and Lp budgets S_pj, the exact positive ledger is C_p sum m_j^((p-2)/p)L_j^(1/p)S_pj^(1/p); if L_j<=m_j L0, Holder recovers the whole-law constant exactly.

For Q=2cU1U2+Z^THZ+aW^2+2(v^TZ)W plus arbitrary displayed outside quadratic/cross couplings, all coordinates independent cap-one, ||p_Q||inf <= 3*2^(7/6)|c|^(-2/3)||v||^(-1/3). If |c|>=1 and ||v||>=1, the family is inside the exact three-large-eigenvalue target.

Using p=12/5 in the completed affine slice-Fresnel/moving-fold branch yields ||p_Q||inf <=2^(31/72)3^(7/6)7^(7/12)=15.1086429339... at |h|>=1/sqrt2, |gamma|>=1, ||v||>=1, improving the partner p=3 constant 20.9817209872... on the same structured branch.
